what: JOIN-1 clip manifest for the GD EoR warlord (the dark knight) cell pack -- this lane's (drax nb_join / join1_render), read off wl_e1/export/final_k_eor3 (E1, R-C9-127/128), the arena push R-C9-132/133

body.revision: eor3 (wl_e1/export/final_k_eor3, R-C9-141): the helm-crown notch removed -- the body mesh's own head no longer pierces the helm crown (e59 crown tuck: 3566 Head-weighted crown vertices pulled under the helm shell by <= 11.9 mm). ONLY vertex POSITIONS differ from eor2: every clip, the skin, UVs, normals, texture and every piece GLB byte-identical. Previous: eor2 (wl_e1/export/final_k_eor2, E1 f734570d2): the extended-arm spin -- only the two spin clips' channels differ from final_k_eor; every other clip byte-identical, the piece meshes, skins and textures byte-identical (the glTF JSON differs only in accessor/bufferView numbering)

idle.source: great sword idle (4), upright, seam-blended loop

eor_spin_start.source: the extended-arm recipe (R-C9-132): one frame of idle with named edits (elbow opened, interior capped 166 deg; shoulder aimed to az 90; no solver), turned rigidly CCW, accelerating to 1200 deg/s and turning 120 deg; the haft slid 0.20 m outward through the fists (e54) -- clip_sources.json

eor_spin_loop.source: the same extended-arm frame, 9 x 40 deg CCW at rate 1.0, closes exactly; the haft slid 0.20 m outward (e54) -- clip_sources.json

warcry.definition: the shout, PROPORTIONAL to GD's own War Cry clip (legolas 2026-10-01-eor-warlord-animation-and-gear: hero01_sword2h_spell_warcry_a01, 19 frames, the shout on its frame 11 = 0.611 of that clip) x this clip's length, on its nearest 30 fps key

eor_spin.b: NOT SHIPPED: recipe (b) is in the comparison film only (wl_e1/export/spin_film); its loop fails the joint-limit lint (left wrist flexion 92 deg at 2 keys) and its feet slide 55-80 mm
eor_spin.moving: in place: the runtime moves him while channelling (canUseWhileMoving)
eor_spin.weapon: weapon_r carries a channel on every spin key (haft through both fists, e12; slid 0.20 m outward, e54 -- so in the spin weapon_r sits off the right fist): the effect reads the mace head off the rig
eor_spin.weapon_head_frames: INFORMATION: this pack's main_tip is weapon_r + 0.9251 m along the bone's +Y (the far point of wl_mace.glb measured in weapon_r's frame; the mace mesh rides weapon_r, so the slide is carried). The integration lane (barrow_full/take/build/r_c9_128.json, dark_knight.weapon_head) reads the mace head at (-3.28, 14.19, -90.42) in weapon_r's unscaled bone space = 1.056 m from the grip at the rig's 0.01153 scale -- a different point and frame (its own runtime attachment); the two are not reconciled here
